text:
Release Bot: post-deploy synth smoke for rollout v2026.07.15 completed. Overall green but embed-prefill probe in ap-south showed p99 latency regressions. dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3978000000 :mag:
Lina: noticed p99 spikes (~1.2s) on /embed/prefill in ap-south at 07:04UTC. small blast radius (10 hosts) but consistent during first 10m of traffic.
perf-bot: synth-summary: prefill-kvcache -> 200 OK but p99=1204ms, occassional 524 for cold-key lookups. variant=v2026.07.15, region=ap-south.
Raj: i'm on-call for ap-south. looking at host traces  cold KV misses trigger model warm path plus remote cache refill, causing tail latency under concurrent prefill bursts. New runtime change reduced eager warmups to save memory, looks like we've under-provisioned warmup for this workload.
QA Lead: log snippet from synth agent:
```
POST /embed/prefill 200 latency=1198ms kv_hit=false trace=tr-07-15-070406
KV fetch -> miss, fetching from origin cache (s3-like), refill async
```
Lina: prefer a minimal mitigation vs rollback. Proposal: 1) pin /embed/prefill in ap-south to previous variant v2026.07.12 2) temporarily raise concurrent prefill warmers on v2026.07.15 (feature flag warmers=8 -> 24) 3) increase synth probe sampling warmup window to 15m then re-run smoke.
deploy-bot: executing: `redwood route pin --route /embed/prefill --to v2026.07.12 --region ap-south`
deploy-bot: pin applied. Traffic now routed to v2026.07.12 in ap-south. :white_check_mark:
SRE: applied feature flag warmers=24 on v2026.07.15 and bumped probe warmup window to 15m for synth agent. Kicking off smoke rerun.
perf-bot: synth-rerun id ss-3978000000-2 started.
perf-bot: rerun finished: 200/200 checks OK, p99=84ms, p95=36ms, no 5xx.
Raj: leaving pin for 30m while we monitor cold-start rates and KV miss ratio. I'll also push a follow-up change to make warmers auto-scale based on cold-miss rate.
Lina: filing INF-10234 "kvcache warmup tuning for prefill long-tail" and attaching traces + replay jobs. Plan to reintroduce v2026.07.15 with warmers default bumped and a 5% canary after hold.
Release Bot: rollout hold set for 30m. Pin active for /embed/prefill in ap-south. Notifying #deploy-notify.
QA Lead: recommend adding a synthetic prefill backfill job to reduce cold-latency for new variants in the future.
Lina: agreed. Thanks team. Will schedule the auto-fill job and follow up on the PR. :thumbsup:
